newsitem.title: USA: Veeco Q4 orders to exceed $25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Veeco Q4 orders to exceed $25 mln.

text.p: Veeco Instruments Inc said on Monday that it anticipates that orders for the fourth quarter of 1996 will exceed $25 million, a record for the company.
Veeco said that it has orders totaling $10 million from Read-Rite Corp and $5 million from Seagate Technology Inc.

The company said that the Read-Rite and Seagate orders are for its Microetch ion beam systems, which are used by hard drive manufacturers for critical etch steps in the fabrication of high density, thin-film inductive and magnetoresistive heads.
The orders are scheduled for delivery in the first half of 1997, Veeco said.
